sections.Profile:
The Temptation pinball machine, produced by Sega Enterprises, Ltd. in 1976, is a solid-state, single-player game with a unique theme centered around happiness and dancing.

- Manufacturer: Sega Enterprises, Ltd.
- Years made: 1976–1977
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State
- Display: Alphanumeric
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Women, Good Times, Society, Dancing, Original Theme, 1970s, Solid State
